reader_os_foundation_probe_2026_10_30.trial_home_and_reader: User confirmed Home visible and Open reader works; service reported foreground=koreader on same boot. Return-to-Home plugin not found and Exit interactions did not return. A subsequent physical power press brought up the lock screen; log shows KOReader exited 0 and input closed, shell reacquired touch, service reports lock=locked on same boot. User confirmed Unlock returns to responsive Home. Wi-Fi, suspend and full lifecycle remain unaccepted. Later on the same boot 55f05ba1-28ff-4d2d-a67c-c010dc8d92da, user confirmed the external lock screen, normal Unlock, entering the reader and page turning. User then confirmed the in-reader Return to Home menu action: KOReader logged exit code 0 at 13:09:29, closed input, the service reaped it, gw-shell restarted and status showed foreground=none/reader-exit=0 with no reader respawn; the transition shows a brief E-ink flash and about 0.5 s delay (not yet optimized); crash-to-Home with a readable error remains unverified.

Existing ath6kl driver and wpa_supplicant were used.
